overview_description.description: Binks was started in 2019 because getting clothes that fit you well and are tuned to your taste should be easy. Why the need to try 2 different sizes of the same outfit in order to be sure that it will fit? Why fall in love with that dress online only to find that the delivered product is flimsy or needs to be altered? It's time for a change.

product.name: FlexiFit™ Readymade Saree Blouses
product.description: Pre-made saree blouses designed with proprietary sizing for a comfortable and flattering fit, available in various styles, neck designs, sleeve lengths, and colors.

product.name: Readymade Kurtas & Kurta Pants Sets
product.description: Pre-assembled ethnic outfits consisting of kurtas paired with matching pants, designed for casual, office, or festive wear.

product.name: Ready To Wear 1-minute Sarees
product.description: Pre-stitched sarees with attached petticoats that can be worn quickly without traditional draping, designed for ease and convenience.

product.name: Readymade Lehenga Skirts & Sets
product.description: Pre-stitched lehenga skirts and coordinated sets designed for weddings and festive occasions.

product.name: Dupattas
product.description: Ethnic scarves or shawls designed to complement traditional Indian outfits like kurtas and lehengas.

product.name: Ethnic Pants for Kurtas
product.description: Traditional Indian pants designed to be worn with kurtas, available in various styles and fabrics.
